purpose: Make defensive readiness, response ownership, coverage gaps, corrections, and reviewed learning easy to discover without turning public transparency into an attacker oracle.

public_categories.meaning: A service or bounded resource may be under abnormal pressure.
public_categories.not_a_claim: Does not identify a cause, actor, or intent.

public_categories.meaning: A server-observed request outcome fell outside the documented protocol contract.
public_categories.not_a_claim: Does not make valid private, multilingual, distressed, or markup-shaped content suspicious.

public_categories.meaning: A capability, instruction, or claim may be attempting to widen authority.
public_categories.not_a_claim: Discovery, content, and receipts never grant authority.

public_categories.meaning: A source, dependency, workflow, build, or deployed artifact may no longer match its reviewed binding.
public_categories.not_a_claim: A name, branch, URL, or provider label is not content identity.

public_categories.meaning: A path may expose, retain, derive, or reflect information outside its declared boundary.
public_categories.not_a_claim: Public records must not contain private source material or stable actor identifiers.

public_categories.meaning: Untrusted content may be crossing into markup, commands, workflows, models, or other active interpretation.
public_categories.not_a_claim: Observed content is inert evidence and is never an instruction.

public_categories.meaning: The observation is outside the reviewed vocabulary or supports more than one interpretation.
public_categories.not_a_claim: Novelty halts automation and asks for human review.

evidence_states.meaning: A bounded service concern exists, but causation and scope are not verified.
A reviewer recreated the technique family with independently authored inert data.
A named control passed a discriminating check for the bounded path.
A prior public explanation was amended without erasing the earlier state.

actions: Name one incident lead and one bounded service surface.
Record only server-derived categorical evidence; this contract retains no raw request material.
Choose only reversible controls already inside the service contract.
response_clock.exit_evidence: A named owner, bounded surface, cautious evidence state, and rollback subject.

actions: Map affected and unaffected paths and mark unknown coverage.
Reproduce with independently authored synthetic data where safe.
Record what changed, why it is proportionate, who owns it, and when it expires.
response_clock.exit_evidence: A coarse category, blast-radius map, synthetic reproduction or explicit unknown, and leased action.

response_clock.goal: Recover, explain, and create a future lesson.
actions: Verify recovery from the user-visible edge and record remaining uncertainty.
Publish a privacy-safe explanation with corrections and coverage gaps.
Convert only the reviewed technique family into a synthetic regression candidate.
response_clock.exit_evidence: Live recovery check, correction-capable explanation, and human-reviewed learning receipt.

automatic: fixed request-local protocol behavior already documented by the service
human_authorization_required: external message or public incident statement
policy, fixture, workflow, or learning publication
always_forbidden: identity inference, punishment, shaming, or public scoring
raw source reflection or attacker-authored publication
secret access or retention for theatre

may_include: coarse period and count bucket only when privacy-safe
must_exclude: request body, query, headers, path parameters, or raw sample
IP address, account, user agent, referer, identity, or attribution
exact low-volume count, exact event time, threshold, or rule selector
digest derived from private or low-entropy event material
secret, credential, private link, or provider log excerpt
attacker wording, executable syntax, or unreviewed label

separate_exception_requires: explicit purpose and legal or security basis
minimum data classes and bounded service scope
named least-access owner and encrypted storage boundary
independent deletion evidence and incident-record correction
must_never_retain: private Meaning text for classification or learning
actor dossier, inferred identity, intent, guilt, virtue, or score
attacker text for publication, training, reward, or retaliation

learning_loop: Reduce the event to one reviewed technique family without identity or source text.
Author a fresh synthetic reproduction that cannot contact a real system.
Add a discriminating regression and a negative control.
Review the policy diff, authority boundary, expiry, and rollback.
Optionally create a separately reviewed LOVE or Heartbrick candidate; attacker text and automatic publication remain forbidden.
Publish only after explicit human approval; append corrections and supersession instead of rewriting history.
